sloka: स वेश्म जालम् बलवान् ददर्श ।व्यासक्त वैदूर्य सुवर्ण जालम् ।यथा महत् प्राव्Rषि मेघ जालम् ।विद्युत् पिनद्धम् सविहम्ग जालम् ॥५-७-१॥
transliteration: sa veśma jālam balavān dadarśa ।vyāsakta vaidūrya suvarṇa jālam ।yathā mahat prāvRṣi megha jālam ।vidyut pinaddham savihamga jālam ॥5-7-1॥

translations.english: Powerful Hanuman beheld the conglomeration of buildings with golden lattices encrusted with vaidurya, with flocks of birds comparable to a complex of clouds pierced by lightning during rainy season.
